_note: 日常薄场景补档 批次A(8个生活刚需)· v2 已采纳双AI审核。保留现有 beginner 档不动,新增 entry(4)/intermediate(9)/advanced(11) 三档。台词表形态(只有学员要说的话)。美式英语+洛杉矶长期居住语境。⚠️ v2 修订要点:①entry 档全面重写——原稿与已有初级档大面积重复,现改为「不同的核心动作」而非初级档的简化版;②unwell advanced 安全修正(疑似急症不得用『还能等等』淡化,费用询问必须限定在非紧急前提下);③lost advanced 事实修正(中国护照补发走「中国领事」APP,不以警方报告为前置,无普遍付费加急);④police 本地化(LAPD 用 DR/incident number,现场先给编号、正式报告另申请);⑤补入美国生活真实高频:prior authorization / in network / advice nurse / 转人工 / 防诈骗回拨 / 标价不含税 / final sale / 普通话口译。

entry.en: I need a refill on this.
Do I need a prescription for this?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我来取处方药。

intermediate.en: It's under Chen — C-H-E-N.
intermediate.zh: 登记名是 Chen——C-H-E-N。

intermediate.en: Sure — my date of birth is May twelfth, nineteen eighty-five.
intermediate.zh: 好的——我的出生日期是 1985 年 5 月 12 日。

intermediate.en: Does my insurance cover this one?
intermediate.zh: 我的保险能覆盖这个药吗？

intermediate.en: Is there a generic version that's cheaper?
intermediate.zh: 有没有便宜一些的仿制药？

intermediate.en: I'm already taking something for allergies — is that a problem?
intermediate.zh: 我已经在吃过敏药了，会有冲突吗？

intermediate.en: Are there any foods or drinks I should avoid while I'm taking this?
intermediate.zh: 吃这个药期间，有什么食物或饮料要避开吗？

intermediate.en: I'm out of refills. Could you contact my doctor for a new prescription?
intermediate.zh: 我的续配次数用完了。能帮我联系医生重开处方吗？

intermediate.en: If it doesn't help, I'll check with my doctor.
intermediate.zh: 要是没效果，我再去问我的医生。

advanced.en: Hi, I got a text saying my prescription is ready for pickup.
advanced.zh: 你好，我收到短信说我的处方药可以取了。

advanced.en: Last time my copay was twenty dollars — is it the same this time?
advanced.zh: 上次我的自付额是二十美元——这次一样吗？

advanced.en: That seems higher than usual. Could you run it through my insurance again?
advanced.zh: 这好像比平时高。能麻烦你再用我的保险走一遍吗？

advanced.en: I just switched plans, so the card on file might be out of date.
advanced.zh: 我刚换了保险计划，你们存档的卡可能过期了。

advanced.en: My insurance says this needs prior authorization. Has the request been sent to my doctor's office?
advanced.zh: 我的保险说这个需要事前授权。申请已经发到我医生诊所了吗？

advanced.en: Is there a manufacturer coupon or discount program for this?
advanced.zh: 这个药有厂家优惠券或折扣项目吗？

advanced.en: My doctor mentioned a lower dose — could you check what was actually sent?
advanced.zh: 我的医生提过要开小剂量的——能帮我核对一下实际开的是什么吗？

advanced.en: Could you set this up on auto-refill for me?
advanced.zh: 能帮我设置成自动续药吗？

advanced.en: I'm traveling next week — can you request a vacation override so I can fill this early?
advanced.zh: 我下周要出门——能申请一个 vacation override 让我提前配药吗？

advanced.en: This medication is out of stock. Could you check another location and transfer the prescription if they have it?
advanced.zh: 这个药缺货了。能帮我查一下别的门店，有的话把处方转过去吗？

advanced.en: Great — I'll wait while you reprocess it.
advanced.zh: 好的——你重新处理，我在这儿等。

entry.en: I feel like I'm going to throw up.
I need to see a doctor.

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to see someone today if possible.
intermediate.zh: 你好，如果可以的话我想今天就看医生。

intermediate.en: I'm a new patient — are you accepting new patients?
intermediate.zh: 我是新病人——你们现在接收新病人吗？

intermediate.en: It started two days ago and it's getting worse.
intermediate.zh: 两天前开始的，而且越来越严重。

intermediate.en: I have a fever, a sore throat, and a bad headache.
intermediate.zh: 我发烧、喉咙痛，还有严重的头痛。

intermediate.en: I took some ibuprofen this morning but it didn't help much.
intermediate.zh: 我今天早上吃了布洛芬，但没什么用。

intermediate.en: I'm not allergic to anything as far as I know.
intermediate.zh: 据我所知我没有任何过敏。

intermediate.en: Are you in network with my plan, and what will my copay be?
intermediate.zh: 你们属于我保险计划的网络内吗？我的自付额是多少？

intermediate.en: Could you help me find an in-network urgent care that's open right now?
intermediate.zh: 能帮我找一家保险网络内、现在还开着的 urgent care 吗？

intermediate.en: Thank you — I'll wait right here.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢——我就在这儿等。

advanced.en: I'm trying to decide whether I should go to urgent care or straight to the ER.
advanced.zh: 我在判断我该去 urgent care 还是直接去急诊室。

advanced.en: The pain is in the lower right side of my abdomen, and it's pretty sharp.
advanced.zh: 疼痛在我腹部的右下方，而且是那种刺痛。

advanced.en: On a scale of one to ten, I'd say it's about a seven.
advanced.zh: 一到十分的话，我觉得大概七分。

advanced.en: It comes and goes, but the episodes are getting closer together.
advanced.zh: 是一阵一阵的，但发作间隔越来越短。

advanced.en: I haven't been able to keep any food down since last night.
advanced.zh: 从昨晚开始我吃什么吐什么。

advanced.en: I'm on medication for high blood pressure — I can show you the bottle.
advanced.zh: 我在吃降压药——我可以把药瓶给你看。

advanced.en: Is there an advice nurse I can speak with before I decide where to go?
advanced.zh: 在我决定去哪儿之前，能先跟分诊护士谈谈吗？

advanced.en: Can you evaluate me here, or do I need to go somewhere that can do imaging?
advanced.zh: 你们这儿能给我做评估吗，还是我得去能做影像检查的地方？

advanced.en: If this isn't an emergency, could you tell me roughly what the tests would cost out of pocket?
advanced.zh: 如果这不算急症，能大概告诉我这些检查自费要多少钱吗？

advanced.en: I'm alone and too dizzy to drive. Should I call 911?
advanced.zh: 我一个人，头晕得没法开车。我该打 911 吗？

advanced.en: If you send me home, what symptoms should make me go to the ER right away?
advanced.zh: 如果让我回家，出现哪些症状我就该立刻去急诊室？

entry.en: Sorry, the line keeps cutting out.
entry.zh: 抱歉，电话一直断断续续。

entry.en: Could you speak a little more slowly?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm calling about an order I placed last week.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想问一下我上周下的订单。

intermediate.en: I'd like to speak to a representative.
intermediate.zh: 我想转人工客服。

intermediate.en: Sure, my order number is 4-8-2-6-1.
intermediate.zh: 好的，我的订单号是 4-8-2-6-1。

intermediate.en: Sorry, could you spell that for me?
intermediate.zh: 抱歉，能帮我拼一下吗？

intermediate.en: Let me grab a pen — go ahead.
intermediate.zh: 我拿支笔——你说吧。

intermediate.en: So just to confirm, it'll arrive by Friday?
intermediate.zh: 所以我确认一下，周五之前会到，对吗？

intermediate.en: If we get disconnected, could you call me back at this number?
intermediate.zh: 万一断线了，能打这个号码回拨给我吗？

intermediate.en: Could you email me a confirmation?
intermediate.zh: 能给我发一封确认邮件吗？

intermediate.en: What should I do if it still hasn't arrived by Friday?
intermediate.zh: 如果周五还没到，我该怎么办？

advanced.en: Hi, I've been on hold for about twenty minutes — I hope you can help me sort this out.
advanced.zh: 你好，我已经等了大概二十分钟——希望你能帮我把这事解决了。

advanced.en: I've called twice about this already, so I'd rather not start from scratch.
advanced.zh: 这件事我已经打过两次电话了，所以我不想再从头讲一遍。

advanced.en: Could you pull up the notes from my previous call?
advanced.zh: 能调出我上次来电的记录吗？

advanced.en: I was told it would be resolved within three business days, and it's now been eight business days.
advanced.zh: 当时说三个工作日内解决，现在已经八个工作日了。

advanced.en: I understand it's not your fault — I just need to know what happens next.
advanced.zh: 我理解这不是你的问题——我只是想知道接下来会怎么处理。

advanced.en: Is there a supervisor I could speak with about this?
advanced.zh: 这件事我能跟主管谈谈吗？

advanced.en: Before you transfer me, could you stay on the line until someone picks up?
advanced.zh: 转接之前，能麻烦你别挂，等有人接了再走吗？

advanced.en: I don't give personal information on incoming calls. I'll call back using the number on your website.
advanced.zh: 我不在别人打进来的电话里提供个人信息。我会用你们官网上的号码回拨。

advanced.en: So the refund will be back on my card in five to seven days. Is that right?
advanced.zh: 所以退款五到七天会回到我卡上。对吗？

advanced.en: Could you put that in writing and send it to my email on file?
advanced.zh: 能把这个写成书面确认，发到我登记的邮箱吗？

advanced.en: I appreciate you staying on this with me.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你一直帮我跟进这件事。

entry.en: Could you text me the address?
entry.zh: 能把地址发短信给我吗？

entry.en: Do I need to bring my insurance card?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning with Dr. Lee if she's available.
intermediate.zh: 你好，如果 Lee 医生有空，我想预约洗牙。

intermediate.en: Are you in network with my specific plan?
intermediate.zh: 你们属于我这个具体保险计划的网络内吗？

intermediate.en: Does my dental plan cover a routine cleaning, and will I owe anything out of pocket?
intermediate.zh: 我的牙科保险涵盖常规洗牙吗？我需要自付多少？

intermediate.en: Anything after three works, since I pick up my kid at two-thirty.
intermediate.zh: 三点以后都行，因为我两点半要去接孩子。

intermediate.en: Could you put me on the waitlist if something opens up sooner?
intermediate.zh: 如果有更早的空位，能把我放进候补名单吗？

intermediate.en: Do I need to fill out any forms before I come in?
intermediate.zh: 来之前我需要填什么表格吗？

intermediate.en: How early should I get there for a first visit?
intermediate.zh: 第一次就诊我应该提前多久到？

intermediate.en: I'll need a Mandarin interpreter for the appointment. Could you arrange one?
intermediate.zh: 这次就诊我需要普通话翻译。能帮我安排一位吗？

intermediate.en: Perfect — see you on the fourteenth.
intermediate.zh: 太好了——十四号见。

advanced.en: Hi, I have an appointment on Thursday that I need to move.
advanced.zh: 你好，我周四有个预约需要改期。

advanced.en: Something came up at work, so I can't make that time anymore.
advanced.zh: 工作上有事，那个时间我去不了了。

advanced.en: I'm calling as soon as I can, but I realize this is less than twenty-four hours' notice.
advanced.zh: 我是一有空就打来的，但我知道这已经不到二十四小时了。

advanced.en: Is there any way to waive the fee, since this is my first time rescheduling?
advanced.zh: 考虑到这是我第一次改期，有办法免掉费用吗？

advanced.en: What's the next opening you have with the same provider?
advanced.zh: 同一位医生下一个空位是什么时候？

advanced.en: I'd rather wait for her than see someone else, if that's not too far out.
advanced.zh: 如果不用等太久，我宁愿等她，也不换别人。

advanced.en: Could you double-check that my insurance is still active on your end?
advanced.zh: 能帮我再确认一下，你们那边我的保险还是有效的吗？

advanced.en: Last time there was a mix-up with my referral — has that been cleared up?
advanced.zh: 上次我的转诊单出过差错——那件事解决了吗？

advanced.en: If the referral expires before the new appointment, will I need a new one?
advanced.zh: 如果转诊单在新预约之前过期了，我需要重新开吗？

advanced.en: Could you confirm the new time by email so I have it in writing?
advanced.zh: 能把新时间用邮件确认一下吗，我好有个书面记录。

advanced.en: Thanks for working that out with me.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你帮我协调这件事。

entry.en: Could you scan this for me?
entry.zh: 能帮我扫一下这个价吗？

entry.en: Does this come in another color?

intermediate.en: Excuse me, is this the sale price or the regular price?
intermediate.zh: 请问这是折后价还是原价？

intermediate.en: Is that the price before tax?
intermediate.zh: 这是税前价格吗？

intermediate.en: The tag says thirty, but it rang up as forty.
intermediate.zh: 标签写的是三十，但结账显示四十。

intermediate.en: Is that price per pound, or is it per item?
intermediate.zh: 那个价格是按磅算还是按件算？

intermediate.en: Do you price-match other stores?
intermediate.zh: 你们跟别的商店比价吗？

intermediate.en: Is there a student or member discount?
intermediate.zh: 有学生折扣或会员折扣吗？

intermediate.en: Is this final sale, or can I still return it?
intermediate.zh: 这个是特价不退不换，还是还能退？

intermediate.en: Could I get a gift receipt with that?
intermediate.zh: 能给我开一张礼品小票吗？

intermediate.en: That works — I'll go ahead and get it.
intermediate.zh: 可以——那我就买了。

advanced.en: Hi, I bought this last week and I'd like to return it.
advanced.zh: 你好，这个我上周买的，我想退货。

advanced.en: I don't have the receipt, but can you look up the purchase using the card I paid with?
advanced.zh: 我没带小票，但能用我付款的那张卡查到这笔交易吗？

advanced.en: I'd prefer a refund to the original card rather than store credit.
advanced.zh: 我希望退回原卡，而不是 store credit。

advanced.en: It went on sale two days after I bought it — can I get a price adjustment?
advanced.zh: 我买完两天后它就降价了——能给我补差价吗？

advanced.en: I understand the sale has ended, but the policy on your site says fourteen days.
advanced.zh: 我知道折扣已经结束了，但你们网站上写的政策是十四天内有效。

advanced.en: Would you mind checking with a manager on that?
advanced.zh: 能麻烦你跟经理确认一下吗？

advanced.en: Actually, could I exchange it for the same thing in a different color instead?
advanced.zh: 其实，我能不能换成同款不同颜色的？

advanced.en: If I order it online, would shipping be free to the store?
advanced.zh: 如果我网上下单，寄到门店免运费吗？

advanced.en: Is the warranty handled through you or through the manufacturer?
advanced.zh: 保修是你们负责还是找厂家？

advanced.en: How long does the refund usually take to post?
advanced.zh: 退款一般多久到账？

advanced.en: Thanks — I appreciate you sorting that out.
advanced.zh: 谢谢——谢谢你帮我处理好。

entry.en: Who can help me with this?

intermediate.en: Excuse me, am I supposed to check in at this machine first?
intermediate.zh: 请问，我是不是要先在这台机器上签到？

intermediate.en: I'm new here and still figuring things out.
intermediate.zh: 我刚来，很多事还在摸索。

intermediate.en: I can't get this machine to take my card.
intermediate.zh: 这台机器读不了我的卡。

intermediate.en: Is there anyone available who speaks Mandarin?
intermediate.zh: 有会说普通话的人吗？

intermediate.en: Would you mind walking me through it once?
intermediate.zh: 能麻烦你带我走一遍流程吗？

intermediate.en: Let me try it myself, and you can tell me if I'm doing anything wrong.
intermediate.zh: 我自己试一遍，做错了你告诉我。

intermediate.en: Is there someone else I should ask about this?
intermediate.zh: 这件事我该问别人吗？

intermediate.en: That makes much more sense now.
intermediate.zh: 现在清楚多了。

intermediate.en: You've been really helpful.
intermediate.zh: 你帮了大忙。

advanced.en: Sorry to interrupt — I know you're busy, but I'm a bit stuck.
advanced.zh: 不好意思打断一下——我知道你很忙，但我卡住了。

advanced.en: I've tried it a couple of ways and I'm clearly missing something obvious.
advanced.zh: 我试了好几种方法，肯定是漏了什么很明显的东西。

advanced.en: The machine charged my card, but nothing happened. Who can help me fix this?
advanced.zh: 机器已经扣了我的卡，但什么都没发生。这个该找谁处理？

advanced.en: Could you check whether the payment actually went through before I try again?
advanced.zh: 在我再试一次之前，能帮我确认这笔钱到底扣成功了没有吗？

advanced.en: Is there a manual or a website where I could look this up myself next time?
advanced.zh: 有说明书或网站吗，下次我可以自己查？

advanced.en: So if I understand right, I need to do that part first?
advanced.zh: 所以如果我理解得没错，我得先做那一步？

advanced.en: Let me repeat it back to make sure I've got it.
advanced.zh: 我复述一遍，确认我记对了。

advanced.en: If I get the same error again, should I take a picture of it?
advanced.zh: 如果又出现同样的报错，我要拍张照吗？

advanced.en: If this still doesn't work, is there a support number I can call?
advanced.zh: 如果还是不行，有客服电话我可以打吗？

advanced.en: Is there a better time of day to catch you?
advanced.zh: 什么时间来找你比较方便？

advanced.en: You've saved me a lot of trouble — thank you.
advanced.zh: 你帮我省了好多麻烦——谢谢你。

entry.en: I think I left it here.
Has anyone turned in a wallet?

intermediate.en: Hi, I think I left my bag here about an hour ago.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想我大概一小时前把包落在这儿了。

intermediate.en: It's a black backpack with a laptop inside.
intermediate.zh: 是个黑色双肩包，里面有台笔记本电脑。

intermediate.en: I was sitting by the window near the entrance.
intermediate.zh: 我当时坐在靠近入口的窗边。

intermediate.en: Has anyone turned anything in today?
intermediate.zh: 今天有人送来失物吗？

intermediate.en: Could you check in the back or ask one of your coworkers?
intermediate.zh: 能查一下后面，或者问问你同事吗？

intermediate.en: Is there a number I could call later to follow up?
intermediate.zh: 有电话号码吗？我晚点可以再跟进。

intermediate.en: Could I leave my name and number in case it shows up?
intermediate.zh: 我能留个姓名和电话吗？万一找到了。

intermediate.en: Do you have security cameras here? Could you save the footage in case the police need it?
intermediate.zh: 这儿有监控吗？能麻烦你把录像保存下来吗，万一警察需要。

intermediate.en: Thanks — I'll check back this evening.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢——我今晚再来看看。

advanced.en: I need to replace my lost Chinese passport. What's the process?
advanced.zh: 我的中国护照丢了，需要补办。流程是怎样的？

advanced.en: I've already retraced my steps and checked with the places I visited.
advanced.zh: 我已经原路找过一遍，也问过去过的地方了。

advanced.en: I'm not sure whether I lost it or it was stolen. Which type of report should I file?
advanced.zh: 我不确定是丢了还是被偷了。我该报哪一类案？

advanced.en: Do you need a police report, or is a written loss statement enough?
advanced.zh: 需要警方报案记录吗，还是一份书面遗失声明就够了？

advanced.en: What documents do I need to upload through the Chinese Consul app?
advanced.zh: 我需要通过「中国领事」APP 上传哪些材料？

advanced.en: My U.S. visa was in the lost passport — how do I report it, and will I need to reapply abroad?
advanced.zh: 丢的护照里有我的美国签证——该怎么申报？需要在境外重新申请吗？

advanced.en: I've canceled my cards, so that part is taken care of.
advanced.zh: 我的银行卡已经挂失了，那部分处理好了。

advanced.en: I need to return to China in five days. Should I apply for an emergency travel document in the Chinese Consul app and then email the consulate?
advanced.zh: 我五天后必须回中国。我应该在「中国领事」APP 上申请旅行证，然后再给领馆发邮件吗？

advanced.en: I have a photo of the passport page on my phone — would that help?
advanced.zh: 我手机里有护照页的照片——那个有用吗？

advanced.en: Could you write down the address and hours for me?
advanced.zh: 能帮我把地址和办公时间写下来吗？

advanced.en: You've been really helpful — thank you.
advanced.zh: 你帮了大忙——谢谢你。

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to report a break-in at my apartment.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我要报案，我的公寓被闯入了。

intermediate.en: I got home around six and found the door unlocked.
intermediate.zh: 我大概六点回到家，发现门没锁。

intermediate.en: I haven't gone inside because I don't know if anyone is still there.
intermediate.zh: 我没有进去，因为我不知道里面是不是还有人。

intermediate.en: I can see that things have been moved around, but I haven't touched anything.
intermediate.zh: 我能看到东西被翻动过，但我什么都没碰。

intermediate.en: I'm outside the building now. Can you send officers to check the apartment?
intermediate.zh: 我现在在楼外。能派警察来查看一下公寓吗？

intermediate.en: I'm at 123 Main Street, apartment 4B, and I'm waiting outside in a safe place.
intermediate.zh: 我在 Main Street 123 号 4B 公寓，正在楼外安全的地方等。

intermediate.en: Will I get a report number I can give my insurance company?
intermediate.zh: 我能拿到一个报案编号给保险公司吗？

intermediate.en: How do I check on the case later?
intermediate.zh: 之后我怎么查询案件进展？

intermediate.en: Thank you for coming out so quickly.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢你们这么快就赶来。

advanced.en: I'd like to file a report, and I want to make sure I give you everything useful.
advanced.zh: 我想报案，也想确保把有用的信息都提供给你。

advanced.en: Could I have a Mandarin interpreter, please?
advanced.zh: 能给我安排一位普通话翻译吗？

advanced.en: It happened between two and four this afternoon, based on when I left and came back.
advanced.zh: 根据我离开和回来的时间，事情发生在今天下午两点到四点之间。

advanced.en: I have the serial number for the laptop and photos of the other items.
advanced.zh: 我有笔记本电脑的序列号，还有其他物品的照片。

advanced.en: The building manager said he can pull the footage if you request it.
advanced.zh: 楼管说如果你们要求，他可以调取监控录像。

advanced.en: I'd rather not confront anyone myself — I'll leave that to you.
advanced.zh: 我不想自己去跟任何人对质——这部分交给你们。

advanced.en: Is there anything I should do to secure the place tonight?
advanced.zh: 今晚我需要做些什么来保障住处安全吗？

advanced.en: Could you give me the DR or incident number and your name and badge number?
advanced.zh: 能给我 DR 编号或事件编号，还有你的姓名和警号吗？

advanced.en: My insurer needs documentation. Can I use the incident number to open the claim, and how do I request the final report?
advanced.zh: 我的保险公司需要证明材料。我能用事件编号先开理赔吗？正式报告怎么申请？

advanced.en: If I remember anything else, who should I contact?
advanced.zh: 如果我想起别的情况，该联系谁？

advanced.en: I appreciate you taking this seriously.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你认真对待这件事。
